newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius rupee stable vs dollar, weaker on pound.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius rupee stable vs dollar, weaker on pound.

text.p: The Mauritius rupee was unchanged against the dollar but weakened versus the pound on Tuesday, following international trends, forex dealers said.
The rupee was posted at a mean commercial rate of 20.084 against the dollar, unchanged from Monday. The rupee traded at a mean of 33.4635 for one pound, from 33.4235 on Monday.
Dealers said the dollar's parity in overseas markets on Tuesday morning was barely changed against Monday morning, leading to its stable fixing against the rupee.
"On the local scene, the market is still long with good supply from the textiles and tourism sectors and demand from importers subdued," one dealer said.
The dealer said forex demand from importers is expected to gradually pick up from their yearend lull in February.
